name: Bundle hedgehog
desc: Bundle hedgehog (Echinocereus fasciculatus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 15 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinocereus fasciculatus, commonly known as pinkflower hedgehog cactus, is a clumping cactus (Cactaceae) with brilliant magenta flowers and long spines found in the Sonoran Desert.
